name: Staged: conversation group facing the window, console behind the sofa on the open side, the right side a play wall
notes:
Staged pick. No TV (F-65); the bottom side is open to the kitchen and dining area, so its 30-inch walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42): nothing stands against it or hangs on it, and it is the route from the stairs to the kitchen and dining room.
The KIVIK floats with its back to the open side and faces the window, with the LACK console behind it as the drop zone for keys and mail; a POÄNG at the coffee table's left end makes an L, and the window wall stays open as the view and a 38" route from the top landing to the play corner. The group sits toward the stairs, on the strip the drawn stair band used to keep clear, so the play floor between the sofa and the toy wall is 74" wide (38" before). The right side is Maddie's play wall (F-61): the SMÅSTAD reading bench in the window corner, a TROFAST below it, a low BESTÅ toy cabinet with her FLISAT book display in the 50" left of the open side's walkway, and the LEN play rug and the LÄTT table in the open floor.
sofa-1 KIVIK, rot 180, x 80.125-169.875, y 85-122.375, facing the window with two thirds of its length in front of the glass (the window's place is eyeballed): its front 79" from the heater face (F-33, 12" needed); the console and then the 30" open-side walkway behind it (F-39: 35.3" behind the console); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
console-1 LACK console, x 97.438-152.562, y 122.375-137.75, against the sofa's back, facing the dining side: lamp-2 STORSEGEL on top, three GNABBAS baskets on its shelf; 5.3" short of the walkway (F-42).
coffee-table-1 LACK, x 107.312-142.688, y 47.375-69: 16" in front of the sofa (F-39); 41.4" between it and the heater face, the route along the window (F-30).
chair-1 POÄNG facing east at the coffee table's left end, x 59.062-91.312, y 44.812-71.562: 16" from the coffee table, 38.8" from the heater face (F-33); floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP behind its left shoulder (x 47-56, y 46-55) for reading, off the rug's edge and 11" off the strip along the railing.
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL at the sofa's left arm, x 58.5-80.125, y 92-113.625, 22.5" past the walkway along the stairs.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", running along the sofa, x 57-175, y 28.375-122.375: the POÄNG, the side table, the sofa and the coffee table stand fully on it, with 2" of rug behind the POÄNG, 1.5" behind the side table and 5.1" past the sofa's right arm; its far edge runs under the sofa's back, so the console and the plant stand off it, on the walkway side; two STOPP FILT underlays under it keep it from sliding. plant-1 FEJKA at the console's left end (x 86-95, y 126-135).
toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD, right-upper wall x 240.5-261, y 18-53.375: the reading seat in the window corner, 12" from the heater face (F-33: a cushion needs 12"); its boxes keep 24" clear in front (F-32). wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST above it and the LÖVA canopy over it (an extra). Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
toy-storage-1 TROFAST, right-upper wall x 243.625-261, y 56.375-93: bins at her height, 24" clear in front (F-32); 20 1/2" tall, no anchoring needed. art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies centered above it (27 1/2" over its 36 5/8"), on the wall the POÄNG faces.
toy-cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4 x 16 1/2 x 15", standing on the floor against the right-lower wall, x 259-275.5, y 94.75-142 (F-63): solid Lappviken push-open doors at her height, no glass, 15" tall (no anchoring needed, 44 lb per surface on the floor); 24" clear in front (F-32); it ends 1" short of the open side's walkway (F-42). book-display-1 FLISAT stands on its end by the step (top layer) with her picture books, wall-lamp-2 VARPTROSS above it (center about 66" up, out of her reach from the floor, its cord in a cover down behind the cabinet), and art-2 RÖDALM over the rest of the cabinet (y 118-137.75).
rug-3 LEN play rug 52 x 63", x 188-240, y 65-128, in front of the TROFAST and the BESTÅ and 13" clear of the TIOKRONA; kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 200-224.75, y 98-116.875, on it: 30.1" from the sofa's right arm, the way from the dining side into the group and onto the play floor (F-30), and 34.25" from the BESTÅ, the way along the play wall; its upper chair clear of the TROFAST's 24" (F-32), its lower chair 15" above the walkway (F-42).
Right side (F-61): the right-lower wall carries the BESTÅ (47 1/4" of the 50" left of the walkway), the 93" right-upper wall the SMÅSTAD and the TROFAST.
Not placed: the TV and every TV unit (F-65); the LILJETRÄD mirror (glass, F-21); the 70 7/8" BESTÅ drawer combination (on the right-lower wall it would reach 24" into the open side's walkway, and the stair side is kept as the walkway along the stairs); the BISSA shoe cabinet, hooks and PERJOHAN bench (the bottom wall they stood on is open); the chaise sofa and the KALLAX units (c, d); the KIVIK ottoman and STOENSE rug (d); the VALLABY rug (c); the kid's POÄNG (c, d); the LAUTERS (e).
Stairs: they run outside the left wall, beyond the measured 261" (F-40; Andrew, 2026-10-24: the stairs add to the room, they are not cut from it), so the floor is whole up to that wall. The stair side is a railing (Andrew, 2026-10-24), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included (y 0-36 and y 137-173): it is the walkway between the stairs' two ends, and nothing Maddie can climb stands at the railing (F-40, F-21). The bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the strip and the route along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown (assumed-position:stairs).
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there, nothing stands under it (F-38), and no art hangs on that wall, so the window is the focal point.
Entry: the old shoe cabinet, hooks and mirror hung on the bottom wall, which is open, so they are gone; the console behind the sofa is the drop zone. The LILJETRÄD mirror that moved to the window wall above the top landing is off the plan too: it is glass (F-21).
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; no storage over 27", so nothing needs anchoring; the VARPTROSS hangs out of her reach from the floor.
Power: the stair side is a railing and the bottom side is open, so outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are is not recorded. The UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords run down the play wall in cord covers. The two STORSEGEL and the TÅGARP need flat floor cord covers to one of those walls, never across the strip along the railing or the open side's walkway and never under the rug; the TÅGARP's cord is 3' 3", so it reaches only an outlet within about 3 feet of it.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, GNABBAS baskets x3 (console shelf), LÖVA canopy x1, STOPP FILT underlays x2 (under the TIOKRONA).
Audit 2026-10-24: the LILJETRÄD mirror is off the plan, because it is glass and F-21 allows none. The LÄTT moved 8" east and the LEN with it, so the way between the sofa's right arm and the play table is 30.1", not 22.1" (F-30). The TIOKRONA turned to run along the sofa: it had been 4" wider than the sofa, with the POÄNG and the side table half off it, and now the whole group stands on it; the TÅGARP stepped 2.5" west, off its edge, and two STOPP FILT underlays keep it from sliding, as in the dining room. A VARPTROSS wall lamp, the dining room's bamboo sconce, gives the play corner its own light. The RÖDALM left the window wall, where it hung over the heater and behind the curtains' stack, for the BESTÅ, and the Waterlilies, which ran past the BESTÅ's end, hangs over the TROFAST, as in e. These notes now record the railing (F-40) and the lamp cords.
